inputs.question: Are offset dimensions shown between driveways on opposite sides of Collier Street? Collier Street is an undivided street. Look for dimension lines showing the distance between the subject site's driveways on the south side of Collier Street and any driveways on the north side of Collier Street.
inputs.regionHint: along Collier Street where subject site driveways connect
inputs.reasoning: The agent is asking whether dimension lines and annotations showing offsets between opposing driveways are present and labeled on the plan view. This is a drawing-element inspection (dimension annotation check), not a measurement task, even though the requirement involves dimensional compliance.

applicableChecklistItems.checklist_deficiency_text: Offsets from opposing driveways not dimensioned on undivided street frontage (DRV-05)

result.answerText: Offset dimensions between driveways on opposite sides of Collier Street are not shown. While driveway widths are dimensioned, there are no dimension lines indicating the offset distance between the north and south driveways.
result.reasoning: I inspected Collier Street along the northern boundary of the subject site. The driveways on the south side of Collier Street connect to the proposed site, and there are existing driveways on the north side of Collier Street. I looked for dimension lines measuring the longitudinal distance along the street between opposing driveways, but none are drawn.
